messages:
ana (devex): thinking about adding a sampled-alert pipeline that ties SDK telemetry to Console alerts. goal: notify customers when per-route token burn spikes or quota anomaly occurs, without pouring raw identifiers into telemetry.

jules (eng-platform): +1. main constraints: keep SDK API tiny, server enforce sampling+throttle, console only shows hashed tenant ids unless customer enables breakdown.

priya (console): UX asks: 1) alert rule builder (route + percentile + delta), 2) preview mock for customers, 3) opt-in toggle in org settings. want example of telemetry payload.

ana (devex): small correction — i'm ana :)

sam (eng): payload idea: minimal event per request, sampled, queued locally. example: 
```
# header: X-RW-Client-Telemetry: optin=quota_alerts;sr=0.02
{
  "tenant_h": "sha256(salt+tid)",
  "route": "chat.complete",
  "tokens": 120,
  "ts": 1700000000,
  "sr": 0.02
}
```
- sr = sample rate. SDK ensures not to exceed 60 telem events/s per key.

nate (eng-sre): server-side must cap ingestion and provide backpressure header: X-RW-Telemetry-Status: accept|throttle. SDK should backoff (expo) and fall back to aggregated-only telemetry endpoints.

jules (eng-platform): SDK surface proposals:
- Py/TS: Telemetry.enable(sample_rate=0.01, alerts=True) / Telemetry.disable()
- Go: env var RW_TELEMETRY=alerts:0.01 + helper func TrapTelemetry() because Go customers often init via main.
- guarantees: non-blocking, bounded queue (default 500 events), drop oldest when full.

priya (console): for alerting, retention and aggregation rules: sampled events -> 1m rollups; alert engine uses 5m windows and has a server-side sample-corrected estimation. retention 90d for sampled, 365d aggregated for billing. need clear consent language.

sam (eng): also call out a breaking risk in Go: older integrations that assume request context will be reused might lose telemetry if we spin a background goroutine. propose helper that accepts context.Context and returns a close func. Migration doc required.

ana (devex): ops-bot canary please for telemetry ingestion?

ops-bot: Canary scheduled: 2025-03-02T09:00:00Z - 2025-03-02T12:00:00Z (teams: devex, eng-platform, console).

nate (eng-sre): propose throttles in RFC: global ingest cap 2500 ev/s, per-tenant soft cap 75 ev/s, queue size 500, server-side sampling override when load>80%.

jules (eng-platform): rollout plan:
- RFC + spec this week
-Py SDK PR + internal canary next week
-TS + demo app week after
-Go helper + migration guide week 3
-console alert UI mock and consent copy by UX end of week 2

priya (console): i'll attach mock images and a sample alert rule text. docs: include quickstart snippet and clear privacy/retention bullets.

an(a) (devex): thanks all. i'll open RFC and link PRs here. cheap note: avoid "tenant" in any telemetry string — always use tenant_h.
